args.prompt:
Create a new KFB claymation ink-blob character sheet using the two attached original references for soft rounded goo anatomy, dark charcoal-plum modeled clay, expressive sculpted eyelids and handmade accessory craft. Exactly six UNIQUE complete figures in three columns by two rows on a TRUE transparent PNG, 1536x1024 landscape. Theme: Steampunk Normality Repair, crews who spend all day restoring a district after the player's destruction. Warm, weary, absurd workplace satire. Shared team kit: dark moss-green short coveralls, plum collars, worn brass and copper instrument housings, muted ivory gloves, rounded clockwork tool accents. Top row Reset Detail, bottom row Continuity Detail. Each separately usable, entire silhouette and every prop comfortably inside its own cell, generous clear margins and gutters. No scenery, floor, shadows, gridlines, signs with text, brands or connected background architecture. Living organic ink faces and rounded soft blob shapes. Clothes wrap the blob's short round body, sparse equipment and short ink hands, no humanoid torso or long human legs. Decontamination workers have full short rounded suits and tiny dark ink feet under the hem. Other crews show rounded goo base lobes under their short clothes. Clear WHITE/IVORY sclera, RED iris and BLACK pupil, filled dark modeled lids. Faces fully visible, dark ink lips. Exactly two subtly female-read figures, cells 2 and 5. Actively DIFFERENT mouth shapes and eye directions within each row, mostly CLOSED. No repeating six giant grins. Prop concepts simple, chunky, plausible-looking inside the cartoon world. Scuffed wood, brass, rubber and cloth, fine fingerprints, soft restrained upper-left light. Gentle charcoal bias with subtle deep plum, preserve dimensional volume. No bright rim halo. Give the crews battle-worn maintenance character, little mends, scuffs and dented tools. Fictional game characters with retro steampunk or modest sci-fi tooling. Row-major roles:
1. Male-read confident service lead, with one portable brass gauge with a single blank dial. slender reverse-comma shape, eager eyes and a narrow open two-upper-tooth grin.
2. Female-read dubiously optimistic seam fixer, with one short roll of wide cream repair tape. broad scalloped silhouette, heavy skeptical eyes and a straight closed dark mouth.
3. Male-read startled reset technician, with one small copper reset box with a single big blank green button. lean pear silhouette, one high brow and a closed crooked determined smirk.
4. Male-read bored continuity keeper, with one small spring-wound clockwork spool. round low body, wide unequal eyes and a tiny startled oval mouth without teeth.
5. Female-read patient cosmetic restorer, with one little brass polishing brush. wide soft square body, half-lidded eyes and a dry closed smile.
6. Male-read quietly worried handoff lead, with one compact green latch case holding a blank replacement facade tile. curved upright body, attentive uneven brows and a tight closed pursed mouth.
Keep every character distinct in silhouette, posture and acting. Tools carried independently at belly or flank. No actual crime evidence, blood or gore. True alpha background in every gap and at outer edges.
